text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky and King Halo are playing a game of shogi in the classroom.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You're wide open! I'll have you in check with this next one!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ack… This isn't looking good.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! My forces need only to advance, all while my king looks on from the safety of his throne!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: A comfortable, yet first-rate victory! Accept your defeat with dignity, Sky!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: A first-rate king observing from his throne, huh? You really okay with that?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …What are you implying?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, nothing. I was just wondering whether victory alone would be enough for a first-rate gal like yourself.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I… I won't fall for any of your ruses. You've always got some manner of scheme afoot!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Come on, can't you hear them? Your pawns are calling out to you.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "As we fight for supremacy on this battlefield…"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ugh, my plan's ruined… I guess this is it…

text_block_list.name: King's Silver General
text_block_list.text: Our enemy is on the brink of defeat! Please, my liege, deliver the final blow!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: The king remains on the throne! I need not dirty my hands!

text_block_list.name: King's Silver General
text_block_list.text: The enemy's morale is low, this is the perfect moment to strike! Demonstrate your might by personally ending the battle!

text_block_list.name: King's Silver General
text_block_list.text: O King! Show us your glory!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …Y-you truly wish to see me finish this?

text_block_list.name: King's Silver General
text_block_list.text: King! King! King! Our lord, O great King! Our first-rate King!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …Heh, heheh! Hahahaha!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! Very well! Then bear witness to the majesty of this first-rate ruler!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Soldiers, feast your eyes upon me! I grant you the right to share tales of this day with your children, and theirs alike!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Th-this is bad! All forces, retreat! Retreat!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …They say, pretending to retreat.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Now, troops! Ambush them!

text_block_list.name: Sky's Forces
text_block_list.text: Raaaah!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: What?! I-impossible! How did you surround me so quickly?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Such a shame… All righty, King. I think you're gonna have to show us what a gracious defeat looks like.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Blast!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …Graciously accepting defeat? How foolish. Do you truly believe that to be appropriate behavior for a first-rate king?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: If you wish for my head, come and take it! But be prepared to taste my blade!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Haha. I knew you'd say that.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But I've already won. ♪
In only a few moves, Seiun Sky deftly lures King Halo's king into danger, then snatches a come-from-behind victory!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Uuugh! Next time… Next time…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Victory will be MIIINE!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: There she goes. Well, that's King for you.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: There she goes. Well, that's King for you.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Haha! You're right about that. It makes her a real pain to handle head-on.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: There! I've calmed my emotions!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Face me once more, Sky! I challenge you to a game of chess!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …What did I tell ya?
Forced to play against King Halo again, Seiun Sky's energy gradually fades. But she also seems to be enjoying herself.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I thought the same at first, but… can you really call that a weakness?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I get how others might think so, but I have a different point of view.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Maybe I could work it into a strategy someday… Haha.
With a profound look on her face, Seiun Sky smiles as she gazes at King Halo storming off.
